english: Lily knew that she had to stop them, so she ran up to the boys and told them that what they were doing was wrong.
ga: Lily le akɛ sani etsi amɛnaa, nohewɔlɛ ejofoi kɛtɛɛ hii lɛ ajɛmɛ ni ekɛɛ amɛ akɛ noni amɛ feo ehiii.

english: The boys were surprised to hear this from Lily, but they listened to her and stopped throwing rocks.
ga: Efee hii lɛ naakpɛ akɛ amɛnu kɛjɛ Lily, shi amɛ bo lɛ toi ni amɛ kpa tɛ lɛ fɔɔ.

english: "What is the meaning of becoming a queen?" asked the young woman.
ga: "Mini ji maŋnyɛ tsɔmɔ shishi", oblayoo lɛ bi.

english: "It is to learn to accommodate all that is," said the old woman.
ga: "Eji ni akase bɔ ni afeɔ atsuɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ lɛ nii," yoomo lɛ kɛɛ.

english: "To hold in your heart the beauty and the pain, the joy and the sorrow, the light and the darkness.To see the world as it is, and to love it nonetheless."
ga: "Ni okɛ fɛo kɛ piŋmɔ, miishɛɛ kɛ awerɛho, la kɛ duŋ awo otsui mli. Ni ona je lɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ lɛ, ni osumɔ lɛ fɛɛ sɛɛ."

english: "But how can I do that?" asked the young woman. "The world is so full of suffering."
ga: "Shi te mafee tɛŋŋ ma fee nakaiŋ" oblayoo lɛ bi lɛ. "Je lɛ eyi kɛ piŋmɔ."

english: "Yes, it is," said the old woman.
ga: "Hɛɛ", Yoomo lɛ kɛɛ.

english: "But it is also full of beauty. And it is our task to find the beauty in the suffering, and to let it transform us.
ga: "Shi eyi kɛ fɛo hu. Ni eji wɔ nitsumɔ akɛ wɔtao fɛo yɛ piŋmɔ lɛ mli, ni wɔha etsake wɔ."

english: "When you become a queen, you will have power.
ga: "Kɛ obatsɔ maŋnyɛ, obaa na hewalɛ.

english: But power is not a thing to be used for your own gain.
ga: Shi hewalɛ jeee no ko ni okɛbaatsu nii kɛha bo diɛŋtsɛ osɛɛnamɔ.

english: It is a responsibility to be used for the good of others.
ga: Eji gbɛnaa nii ni esa akɛ akɛtsu nii kɛha mɛi krokomɛi ahilɛkɛhamɔ.

english: You must learn to use your power to heal the world, not to harm it.
ga: Esane okase ni okɛ ohewalɛ atsa jeŋ lɛ, jeee ni okɛ baa pila lɛ.

english: You must also learn to be humble.
ga: Esane okase shebaa hu.

english: A queen is not above others, but she is also not below them."
ga: Manyɛ bɛɛɛ jwɛi tsɔ fee mei komɛi, shi ebɛɛɛ amɛ shishi hu.

english: Cricket is a game played with a bat and ball between two teams of eleven players on a field at the centre of which is a 22-yard pitch with a wicket at each end, each comprising two bails balanced on three stumps.
ga: Cricket ji shwɛmɔ ni akɛ tso kɛ bɔlu tswaa yɛ shwɛmɔ kui enyɔ ateŋ ni yɔɔ shwɛmɔ bii nyɔŋma kɛ ekome yɛ shwɛmɔ shikpɔŋ nɔ ni ji yale 22 ni yɔɔ wiket yɛ naagbee, fɛɛ yɛ bails enyɔ yɛ stumps etɛ nɔ.

english: The game proceeds when a player on the fielding team, called the bowler, bowls the ball from one end of the pitch towards the wicket at the other end, with an opposing player called the batsman attempting to strike the ball with his bat so that it travels far enough to allow him to run between the wickets, scoring runs.
ga: Shwɛmɔ tsaanɔ kɛji shwɛlɔ yɛ ŋmɔ mli kuu lɛ, ni atsɛɔ lɛ bowler, tswaa bɔluu lɛ kɛjɛ piitsii lɛ naagbee kome kɛtee wicket yɛ naagbee kroko, kɛ shwɛlɔ ni teɔ shi ewoɔ amɛ ni atɛɔɔ lɛ batsman mii fee ni etswa bɔluu kɛ tso koni efa gbɛ kɛ shɔɔ koni eha lɛ gbɛ ni ejofoi yɛ wickets atɛŋ, eewo foidamɔi.

english: The fielding side tries to prevent this by stopping the ball with their own bats, with their hands or with the wicket itself and then throwing the ball back to the bowler.
ga: Fielding gbɛ bɔmɔdɛŋ ni amɛ kpa bɔɔluu lɛ kɛ amɛ tso, kɛ amɛ nine loo kɛ wicket diɛŋtsɛ ni kɛkɛ amɛ fɔ bɔɔluu lɛ kɛha bowler.

english: Cricket is a game that requires a lot of skill and practice.
ga: Cricket shwɛmɔ lɛ hia hesaa kɛ nifeemɔ babaoo.

english: It can be a very rewarding game, but it also takes a lot of hard work.
ga: Eji shwɛmɔ ni yɛ sɛɛnamɔ, shi ehiaa nitsumɔ ni naa waa babaoo hu.

english: If you want to be a good cricketer, you need to be honest with yourself about your abilities and be willing to put in the time and effort to train.
ga: Kɛji otao ni ofee cricketer kpakpa lɛ, ebaa hia okɛ ohe eye anɔkwale yɔ onyɛmɔ ni yɔɔ he miishɛɛ akɛ ekɛ be kɛ mɔdɛŋbɔɔ baa wo tsɔsemɔ mli.

english: Vegetarian cuisine encompasses a wide variety of dishes and ingredients that are prepared without the use of meat, poultry, or fish.
ga: Niyenii ni akɛ ŋmaa fee yɛ niyenii henɔi kɛ nihoomɔ nibii ni ahoɔ ni loo, wuɔ, aloo loo.

english: While some vegetarians avoid all animal products, including dairy and eggs, others may consume dairy or eggs but not meat.
ga: Be mli ni mɔ ni yeee ŋmaa yeee kooloo nibii tamɔ, mliki kɛ wuɔ wɔlɔ, mɛi komɛi yeɔ mliki loo wuɔ wɔlɔ shi amɛ yeɔ loo.

english: There are many reasons why people choose to adopt a vegetarian diet, including ethical concerns about the treatment of animals, environmental concerns about the impact of animal agriculture on the planet, and health concerns about the consumption of meat.
ga: Nɔhewɔi babaoo hewɔ ni mɛi yeee ŋmaa nii, tamɔ bɔ ni afeeɔ koolooi haomɔ, shihilɛ haomɔi yɛ koolooi akwɛmɔ mli yɛ shibɔlemɔ ŋulami, kɛ hewalɛ haomɔ yɛ loo yeli he.

english: Vegetarian food can be just as delicious and satisfying as meat-based dishes, and there are a number of ways to incorporate plant-based proteins into your diet.
ga: Niyenii ni akɛ ŋmaa fee nyɛɔ eŋɔɔ ni etɔɔmɔ tamɔ niyenii ni akɛ loo fee, ni gbɛi babaoo yɛ ni obaanyɛ okɛ ŋmaa niyenii awo oniyenii mli.

english: Some popular vegetarian proteins include beans, lentils, tofu, tempeh, and seitan.
ga: ŋmaa niyenii ni ale waa tamɔ yɔɔ, lɛntils, tofu, tɛmpɛh, kɛ sɛitan.

english: There are also a number of meat substitutes available on the market, such as veggie burgers, chicken nuggets, and soy-based hot dogs.
ga: Loo tsakemɔ komɛi hu yɛ jara lɛ nɔ, tamɔ burga ni akɛ ŋmaa feɔ, wuɔ loo nugɛts, kɛ hot dog ni akɛ soya fee.

english: If you're new to vegetarian cooking, there are a number of resources available to help you get started.
ga: Kɛji kpaa ko ole ŋmaa nihoomɔ lɛ, nii ni he hia babaoo yɛ ni baa ye ebua bo ni oje shishi.

english: There are cookbooks, websites, and blogs dedicated to vegetarian cuisine, and there are also a number of cooking classes available.
ga: Hihoomɔ woji yɛ, wɛbsait, lɛ blɔgs yɛ ni afee kɛ ha ŋmaa niyenii, ni nihoomɔ nikasemɔ komɛi hu yɛ.

english: With a little creativity and experimentation, you can easily create delicious and satisfying vegetarian meals for yourself and your family.
ga: Kɛ nibii ahe nilee kɛ shikpamɔ fioo lɛ, obaanyɛ ni ohoo ŋmaa niyenii ni ŋɔɔ kɛha ohe kɛ owekumɛi.

english: In a large bowl, combine the oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
ga: Yɛ tsɛnsi agbo mli, tsa fɔ, wain ni joɔ, ŋoo kɛ shitɔ.

english: Add the chicken and toss to coat.
ga: Kɛji wuɔ loo lɛ afata he ni ofɔmɔ ni emɔ he.

english: Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to overnight.
ga: Bu naa ni okɛ wo frijii mli kɛ ehooo kraa minitii 30, loo jeŋnamɔ sɛɛ.

english: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
ga: Ha ni flɔnɔɔ mli edɔ kɛyashi degree F 400 (degree C 200).

english: Place the chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
ga: Kɛ wuɔ loo lɛ afɔ nishaa sɛnsii ko nɔ ni osha lɛ minitii 20-25, loo keyashi beni ebaa be kraa.

english: Serve immediately.
ga: Ha lɛ amrɔ nɔŋŋ.

english: Here are some variations on this recipe:
ga: Naa henɔi komɛi yɛ niyenii hoomɔ nɛɛ:

english: * Marinate the chicken in a mixture of olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and herbs.
ga: * Wo wuɔ loo lɛ he mutso mli mu, abonua mli nu, galik, kɛ tsofai.

english: * Add some chopped vegetables to the marinade, such as red onion, bell pepper, or zucchini.
ga: * Kɛ aduawai ni afɔlɔ afata he, tamɔ sabolai tsuru, shitɔ agboi, loo zukiini.

english: * Serve the chicken with a side of rice, quinoa, or salad.
ga: *Ha wuɔ loo kɛ omɔ yɛ masɛi, Quinoa loo saladi.

english: I mean, it’s no Citizen Kane, but it’s a solid movie.
ga: Mi kɛɛ, jeee Citizen Kane ni, shi sini kpakpa ni.

english: The acting is good, the story is interesting, and the cinematography is beautiful.
ga: Sini feemɔ lɛ hi, adesa lɛ he yɛ miishɛɛ, ni sini nifeemɔ lɛ yɛ fɛo.

english: I especially liked the way the director used light and shadow to create a sense of atmosphere.
ga: Esumɔ bɔ ni sini kudɔlɔ kɛ kane kɛ susuma fee kɔɔyɔŋ henumɔ lɛ.

english: Overall, I think it’s a well-made film that is worth watching.
ga: Fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ejwɛŋɔ akɛ eji sini ni afee lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni esa akɛ akwɛ.

english: Of course, it’s not perfect.
ga: Eyɛ mli akɛ, eyeee muu.

english: The pacing could be a little tighter, and some of the characters are a bit one-dimensional.
ga: Oya feemɔ mli baanyɛ ni ewa fioo, ni mɛi ni yɔɔ mli lɛ yɛ ŋwɛi gbɛ kome tsɔ.

english: But overall, I think the film is more than the sum of its parts.
ga: Shi fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ejwɛŋmɔ ji sini lɛ hi fe ehenɔi ni akɛ tsa.

english: It’s a well-crafted story that will stay with you long after you’ve finished watching it.
ga: Eji adesa ni afee lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni kɛ bo baa hi shi bei babaoo kɛji okwɛ ogbenaa.

english: If you’re looking for a movie that will challenge you intellectually, this probably isn’t the one for you.
ga: Kɛji otao sini ni baa tsalenji onilee lɛ, bɛ jeee noko ni obaa sumɔ.

english: But if you’re looking for a good old-fashioned story that will entertain you from start to finish, then I highly recommend it.
ga: Shi kɛji otao adesa kpakpa ni baa ha bo miishɛɛ kɛjɛ shishijee kɛyashi naagbee, bɛ ma kɛɛ okwɛ no.

english: Here are a few more specific things I liked about the movie:
ga: Naa nibii pɔtɛɛ ko mi sumɔɔ yɛ sini lɛ he:

english: * The acting was really good.
ga: *Sinifeemɔ lɛ hii waa.

english: The main character was especially believable, and I could really feel his pain and anguish.
ga: Sini lɛ mli oti fe fɛɛ tsu nii lɛ ojogbaŋŋ, ni enu piimɔ kɛ haomɔ ni etsɔ mli lɛ he.

english: * The story was interesting and kept me engaged throughout the film.
ga: *Adesa lɛ yɛ miishɛɛ ni mi kwɛ sini lɛ fɛɛ.

english: I was always curious to see what would happen next.
ga: Miitao ma na nɔni baaba sɛɛ mli.

english: * The cinematography was beautiful.
ga: *Sini lɛ yɛ fɛo.

english: The director used light and shadow to create a sense of atmosphere that was really effective.
ga: Sini kudɔlɔ lɛ kɛ kane kɛ susuma kɛ fee kɔɔyɔɔŋ ni mɔ shi.

english: Overall, I think this is a solid movie that is worth watching.
ga: Fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ejwɛŋ akɛ sini kpakpa ni esa akɛ akwɛ.

english: It’s not perfect, but it’s a well-made film that will stay with you long after you’ve finished watching it.
ga: Eyeee emuu, shi eji sini ni afee lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni baa fata ohe kɛ tsɛ kɛji okwɛ ota.

english: The view from the top of the mountain was breathtaking.
ga: Shikamɔ kɛjɛ gɔŋ lɛ ŋwɛi yɛ fɛo waa.

english: The sun was shining, the birds were singing, and the clouds were below us.
ga: Hulu lɛ miikpɛ, looflɔi lɛ mii la, ni atatu lɛ yɛ wɔ shishigbɛ.

english: I couldn't believe how high up we were.
ga: Eheee eyeee bɔ ni jwɛi wɔ yɔɔ.

english: We had hiked for hours to get here, and it was worth every step.
ga: Wɔ nyiɛ ŋmɛlɛtswaai kɛshɛ jɛmɛ, shi esa gbɛtsɔɔmɔ fɛɛ.

english: As we stood there taking in the view, a truck drove by.
ga: Ni wɔ damɔ shi wɔŋkwɛ shikamɔ, tsɔne ko ba yo.

english: It was a big, old truck, and it was covered in mud.
ga: Eji tsɔne ni da, emomo, ni ehe ewo ŋmɔtɔ.

english: The driver was sticking his head out the window, and he was smiling.
ga: Tsɔne kudɔlɔ jie eyitso kpo kɛjɛ samflɛ lɛ mli, ni efee ehiɛ ŋmɔlɔŋmɔlɔ.

english: He must have been enjoying the view as much as we were.
ga: Efee akɛ lɛ hu ekwɛ shikamɔ tamɔ wɔ nɔɔ.

english: We watched the truck drive away, and then we turned our attention back to the view.
ga: Wɔ kwɛ tsɔne kudɔ kɛtee, ni wɔ tsɔ wɔ jwɛmɔ kɛtee shikamɔ lɛ nɔ.

english: We stayed up there for a while, just enjoying the moment.
ga: Wɔ hi jɛmɛ bei fioo, ni eye bei lɛ he miishɛɛ.

english: It was a perfect day, and we were glad we had made the effort to hike up the mountain.
ga: Eji gbi ni ye emuu, ni wɔ miishɛɛ wɔhe akɛ wɔ bɔmɔdɛŋ wɔ nyiɛ kɛ tee gɔŋ ŋwɛi.

english: As we started to hike back down, we realized that the view was even better from below.
ga: Bei wɔ bɔi nyiɛmɔ kɛ baa shishigbɛ lɛ, wɔ na akɛ shikamɔ lɛ hii kɛjɛ shishigbɛ kraa.

english: We could see the truck in the distance, and it looked like a tiny speck.
ga: Wɔ nyɛ wɔ na tsɔne lɛ yɛ shɔɔŋ, ni efee tamɔ kuli bibioo ko.

english: It was amazing to think that we had just been up there, looking down at it.
ga: Ejɛ naakpɛɛ ni ojwɛŋ akɛ wɔ tee ŋwɛi etsɛko, wɔ kwɛ lɛ yɛ shishi gbɛ.

english: The hike down was easier than the hike up, and we made it back to our car in no time.
ga: Nyiɛmɔ kɛyaa jwɛi wa fe nyiɛmɔ kɛ ya shikpɔŋ lɛ, ni wɔ shɛ wɔ tsɔne lɛ he nɔɔ.

english: On April 24, 1980, eight U.S. helicopters carrying Delta Force and other U.S. special operations troops launched from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz.
ga: Yɛ Aɛbei 24,1980, U.S. kɔɔyɔɔŋ lɛlɛ wo Delta Force kɛ U.S. asrafoi krokomɛi ni ajie kɛjɛ kɔɔyɔɔŋ lɛlɛ USS Nimitz.

english: The helicopters were supposed to land at the U.S.
ga: Esane kɔɔyɔɔŋ lɛlɛ lɛ eya ma U.S. shikpɔŋ nɔ.

english: Embassy in Tehran, where they would rescue the hostages.
ga: Tehran maŋ anajiaŋdɔmɔlɔ, ni amɛ jie mɛi ni amɔmɔ amɛ lɛ.

english: However, one of the helicopters crashed in the desert, killing eight U.S. servicemen.
ga: Shi kɛlɛ, kɔɔyɔɔŋ lɛlɛ lɛ gbee shi yɛ shiaŋa lɛ mli, ni egbe U.S. asrafoi kpaanyɔ.

english: The remaining helicopters were forced to abort the mission.
ga: Kɔɔyɔɔŋ lɛji ni shwɛ lɛ aha amɛ kpa nitsumɔ lɛ.

english: The failed rescue attempt was a major embarrassment for the Carter administration.
ga: Jiemɔ ni yeee omanye lɛ fee higbele nii aha Carter gbejianɔtoo lɛ.

english: It also damaged America’s reputation in the world.
ga: Efite Amerika gbɛi yɛ jeŋ lɛ fɛɛ hu.

english: In the aftermath of the failed rescue attempt, Carter ordered a boycott of Iranian oil.
ga: Jiemɔ ni yeee omanye sɛɛ lɛ, Carter fa ni amɛ tsi amɛ he yɛ Iranian fɔ he.

english: He also imposed economic sanctions on Iran.
ga: Ekɛ shika shidaamɔhe toigbalamɔ fɔ Iran nɔ.

english: The Iranian government released the hostages on January 20, 1981, just minutes after Ronald Reagan was sworn in as President of the United States.
ga: Iranian nɔyeli ŋmɛɛ mɛi amɔmɔ amɛ lɛ he yɛ Aharabata 20, 1981, minitii sɛɛ mli ni awo Ronald Reagan akɛ United States nɔyelɔ.

english: The noble steed, a symbol of strength and grace, has been a mainstay of human civilization for millennia.
ga: Tawuu ablade, Kadimɔ ni tsɔɔ hewalɛ kɛ duromɔ, efee gbɔmɔ hiɛgbɛgbelemɔ titiri ko afii akpei.

english: From the battlefields of antiquity to the modern racetrack, horses have played a vital role in our history.
ga: Kɛjɛ tawuu na kɛtee ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ foijee, okpɔŋɔi etsu nii ni he hia waa yɛ wɔ yinɔsane.

english: But what is it about horses that makes them so special?
ga: Shi meni yɛ okpɔŋɔi ahe ni haa amɛ fiɔ krɛdɛɛŋ

english: What is it that draws us to these magnificent creatures?
ga: Meni gbala wɔ kɛyaa adebɔi kpeteŋ kpele nɛɛ.

english: Perhaps it is their beauty, with their sleek coats and flowing manes.
ga: Benɛ amɛ hefɛo hewɔ, kɛ amɛ he ni kpɛlɛɔ kɛ amɛ kuɛ he tsɔi ni hoɔ.

english: Perhaps it is their strength, as they can carry us on their backs for miles.
ga: Benɛ eji amɛ hewalɛ, ni amɛ nyɛɔ amɛ woɔ wɔ yɛ amɛ sɛɛ gbɛ kakadaŋŋ.

english: Or perhaps it is their intelligence, as they are capable of learning a wide variety of tasks.
ga: Loo benɛ eji amɛ nilee, ni amɛ baanyɛ amɛ kase nibii srɔtoi babaoo.

english: Whatever the reason, there is no denying the bond that exists between humans and horses.
ga: Nɔ fɛɛ nɔ hewɔ ni ji, anyɛɛɛ aje tsakpaa ni yɔɔ gbɛmɛi kɛ okpɔŋɔ teŋ ŋwane.

english: They are truly partners in life, and their companionship is a gift to be cherished.
ga: Lɛɛlɛŋ hefatalɔ yɛ wala mli ji amɛ, ni amɛ naanyobɔɔ ji nikeenii ni esa akɛ ejara awa aha wɔ.

english: One of the most remarkable things about horses is their ability to sense our emotions.
ga: Noko kome ni sa kadimɔ fe fɛɛ yɛ okpɔŋɔii ahe ji amɛ nyɛmɔ ni fuɔɔ wɔ henumɔi.

english: They can tell when we are happy, sad, or scared, and they will often respond in kind.
ga: Amɛ le kɛji wɔ mii eshɛ wɔ he, awerɛho, loo gbeyee, nii bei pii lɛ amɛ heleɔ kɛ mɔbɔnalɛ.

english: This makes them ideal companions for people who are lonely or who need emotional support.
ga: Enɛ ha amɛ feɔ naanemɛi kɛha gbɔmɛi ni he efee shoo loo henumɔ sɛɛfimɔ hia amɛ.

english: In addition to their companionship, horses can also be used for a variety of purposes.
ga: Kɛ fata amɛ naanyo he lɛ, abaanyɛ akɛ okpɔŋɔi afee nibii srɔtoi.

english: They can be ridden for pleasure, used for work, or even raced.
ga: Abaanyɛ ata amɛ kɛha miishɛɛ, kɛha nistumɔ, loo foidamɔ.

english: Grandma: What can I help you with today, my dear?
ga: Naa: Meni manyɛ ma fee ha bo ŋmɛnɛ, mi bi?

english: Grandchild: I'm feeling really unmotivated.
ga: Nabi: Ehe kanyaaa mi kraa.

english: I have a lot of work to do, but I can't seem to get started.
ga: Eyɛ nitsumɔ babaoo tsumɔ, shi enaa bɔ ni ma je shishi.

english: Grandma: I know how you feel.
ga: Naa: Mi le nɔni otsɔɔ mii.

english: Sometimes, motivation can be hard to come by.
ga: Bei komɛi lɛ, hekanyamɔ namɔ wa.

english: But there are a few things you can do to help yourself get started.
ga: Shi nibii fioo yɛ ni baanyɛ eye ebua bo ni oje shishi.

english: First, think about why you're doing the work.
ga: Klɛŋklɛŋ, jwɛŋmɔ nɔni hewɔ ni otsuɔ nitsumɔ lɛ.

english: What's your goal?
ga: Meni ji oti ni ookɛ ma ohiɛŋ

english: Once you know what you're working towards, it's easier to stay motivated.
ga: Kɛji ole nɔni ka ohiɛ hewɔ ni otsuɔ nii lɛ, ewaaa akɛ obaa kanya ohe.

english: Second, break down the task into smaller steps.
ga: Nɔ ni ji enyɔ, jalamɔ nitsumɔi lɛ mli owo gbɛtsɔɔmɔi bibii amli.

english: This will make it seem less daunting and more manageable.
ga: Enɛ baa hani efeee gbeyei ni abaanyɛ atsu he nii.

english: Third, give yourself rewards for completing each step.
ga: Nɔni ji etɛ, ha ohe nyɔmɔwoo kɛji ogbe gbɛtsɔɔmɔ fɛɛ eko naa.

english: This will help you stay on track and motivated.
ga: Enɛ baa ha ni ohi gbɛ nɔ ni oyɔɔ nɔ ni ekanya bo.

english: Finally, don't be afraid to ask for help if you need it.
ga: Naabgee lɛ, kaaa shee gbeyee ni obi ni oye abua bo kɛji ehe hia bo.

english: Sometimes, all you need is a little encouragement to get you started.
ga: Bei komɛi lɛ, hewalɛwoo fioo ji nɔni he ohia ni oje shishi.

english: Grandchild: Thank you, Grandma.
ga: Nabi: Miida bo shi, Naa.

english: I'll try those things.
ga: Ma bɔmɔdɛŋ ni mafee nakai nibii lɛ.

english: Grandma: You're welcome, my dear.
ga: Naa: Kaa dashi, mi bi.

english: I'm always here for you.
ga: Mi yɛ biɛ aha bo daa.

english: Rental cars are a convenient way to get around when visiting a new city or country.
ga: Tsɔne ni ahai ji gbɛ ni sa ni akɛ bɔleɔ shi kɛji osara maŋji ehe.

english: They offer the flexibility to explore at your own pace and can be a more affordable option than public transportation.
ga: Amɛ haa tsakemɔi koni okwɛ mli bɔ ni otao ni ejara waaa tamɔ tsɔne ni maŋbii kɛfaa gbɛ.

english: When renting a car, it is important to compare prices from different companies and to read the fine print of the rental agreement carefully.
ga: Kɛji ohai tsɔne lɛ, ehe hia ni okɛ nyɔmɔwoo kɛjɛ hei srɔtoi baa to amɛ he ni okane nɔfeenɔ yɛ gbeekpamɔ lɛ mli ojogbaŋŋ.

english: Be sure to ask about any additional fees, such as fuel charges, insurance, or tolls.
ga: Bɔɔmɔdɛŋ ni obi nyɔmɔwoo fɛɛ ni fata he, tamɔ pɛtro nyɔmɔwoo, inshɔrans, loo gbɛjegbɛ tol.

english: It is also a good idea to take pictures of the car before you drive it away, so that you have proof of its condition in case of any damage.
ga: Ehi waa hu akɛ obaa sha ktsɔne lɛ mfoniri dani okudɔ yɛ ya, koni ona odaseyeli yɛ bɔ ni eyɔɔ kɛji naagbai ko yɛ he.

english: If you are planning to rent a car for an extended period of time, you may be able to get a better deal by purchasing a rental car package.
ga: Kɛji ooto ni ohai tsɔne kɛha bei ni mii ekpa lɛ, obaanyɛ ni ona gbɛjianɔtoo kpakpa kɛ ohe tsɔne ni akɛ ha.

english: These packages typically include a set number of days of rental, as well as unlimited mileage and other extras.
ga: Gbi abɔ ni obaa hai tsɔne lɛ, gbɛfaa ni etaa kɛ krokomɛi fɛɛ fata gbɛjianɔtoi titiri nɛɛ he.

english: You may also be able to get a discount if you book your rental car in advance.
ga: Obaanyɛ ni ona nɔtsemɔ kɛji ohai tsɔne lɛ ato.

english: When picking up your rental car, be sure to inspect it carefully for any damage.
ga: Kɛji otee tsɔne ni ohai lɛ womɔ, feemɔ akɛ okwɛ lɛ jogbaŋŋ ni noko fiteko yɛ ehe.

english: If you see any damage, be sure to note it on the rental agreement.
ga: Kɛji ona akɛ noko efite yɛ he, bɔmɔdɛŋ ni okadi yɛ tsɔne haimɔ gbeekpamɔ mli.

english: You should also take pictures of the car before you drive it away.
ga: Esane osha tsɔne lɛ mfoniri hu dani kudɔ tsɔne kɛya.

english: The Uganda Martyrs are a group of 23 Anglican and 22 Roman Catholic Christians who were killed between 1885 and 1887.
ga: Uganda la odasefoi ji kui ni Anglikan bii 23 kɛ Roman katolik kristofoi 22 ni agbe amɛ kɛjɛ 1885 kɛtee 1887 bei amli.

english: They were killed by the king of Buganda, Mwanga II, for refusing to renounce their faith.
ga: Maŋtsɛ Buganda, Mwanga II, gbe amɛ, yɛ amɛ hemɔkɛyeli ni amɛ kpooo hewɔ.

english: The martyrs were canonized by Pope Paul VI in 1964.
ga: Pope Paul VI fee la odasefoi lɛ hetselɔi yɛ 1964.

english: They are considered to be among the most important figures in the history of Christianity in Uganda.
ga: Ayɔse amɛ kɛfata mɛi ni he hia waa yɛ Kristofoi ablema saji yɛ Uganda.

english: The Uganda Martyrs' Day is celebrated on June 3rd every year.
ga: Ayɛɔ Uganda Martyrs' Day yɛ Otukwajaŋ gbi ni ji etɛ nɔ daa afi.

english: It is a national holiday in Uganda and is observed by Christians all over the world.
ga: Eji maŋ hejɔɔmɔ gbi yɛ Uganda ni Kristofoi yɛ jeŋ fɛɛ ni yeɔ.

english: The martyrs are remembered for their courage and their willingness to die for their faith.
ga: Akaiɔ la odasefoi yɛ amɛ ekaa kɛ amɛ suɔmɔ ni amɛ baa gbo aha amɛ hemɔkɛyeli.

english: They are an inspiration to Christians everywhere.
ga: Amɛ ji mumɔ tsirɛ kɛha Kristofoi yɛ he fɛɛ he.
